master_workbook_inventory.publication_role: Approved inventory and backend calculation scope

verified_web_analytics_register.publication_role: Link-level web analytics, exhaustive tables and mapped geometry
verified_web_analytics_register.rule: Never scale or duplicate verified geometry to force agreement with an inventory headline

calculation_policy: Use 275,447 km, 31,106 links and 135 districts for approved all-road inventory calculations.
Use the verified web register denominator for link-level condition, traffic, structures, cost and map analytics.
Show the denominator and scope beside any calculation that could otherwise be confused with the approved inventory.
Retain missing observations as Not supplied; do not fabricate values or geometry.
Report affected or allocated road length together with complete record count and categorical frequency.
Route districts, countries and every dimension with more than 12 populated categories intact to exhaustive and deep-analytics tables; never publish a Top-N substitute.
Treat structure exposure as allocated linked-road length so repeated structures on one link do not multiply the road-length total.

geospatial_reconciliation_policy.geometry_rule: Do not scale, clone or fabricate geometry to manufacture agreement with the approved inventory.
geospatial_reconciliation_policy.public_reporting_rule: Public dashboards use the authoritative inventory total; technical mapped-register and source-verification coverage remain in Admin Tools.
geospatial_reconciliation_policy.high_cardinality_rule: Complete dimensions remain available in tables and exports rather than selective charts.
